violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed Employee wipe counters then handled food without washing hands.
General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint.
Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Observed employee not wearing single use gloves while handling pizzas.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth stored on counter between use.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Observed food chicken, pork repackaged in walk in cooler without date marking.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Observed some of the cold hold refrigerators did not have temperature measuring devices.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Ice chute on drink machine contained black substance. Observed building up of product in dispensing tubes.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Observed pizza cooker contained build up of debris in roller area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Observed build up of food and debris on floor.
